data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'S-D-D' meaning 'to help, to heal, or to support'. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asuda usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Asuda can also be a reminder for parents and family members to be there for their loved ones, to provide them with the necessary help and guidance to overcome challenges.

In naming a child Asuda, parents acknowledge the key role their child will play in healing and supporting their family and community.
